html:
On 10 October 2010 the Netherlands Antilles ceased to exist. Curacao and Sint Maarten became separate countries within the Kingdom of the Netherlands, like Aruba before them.

The three smallest islands, Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba, became special municipalities of the Netherlands itself, with Dutch law and the US dollar.

Each island had voted in referendums in the 2000s. They had long resented being run from Willemstad, and the federation had little life of its own. The kingdom now has four countries: the Netherlands, Aruba, Curacao and Sint Maarten.
sum: On 10 October 2010 the Netherlands Antilles ceased to exist. Curacao and Sint Maarten became separate countries within the Kingdom of the Netherlands, like Aruba before them.
